title: Tectonic Archive — Archive of the Split Mountain
status: DRAFT authoring-only; no native simulation clearance

coordinate_contract.host_clearing: none; negative space assumes cleared host

style_guide.geometry: Split stratigraphic folios, anticline curves, trilobite seals, horizontal archive desks, core-index bars
style_guide.rhythm: Tall fracture → low folded pages → circular fossil → slim core sample → shattered cliff → low terrace; 20–28 cell gaps
style_guide.color: Graphite/slate and basalt background, pale limestone and marble folios, warm sandstone registers, very sparse gold/brass and quartz annotation
style_guide.lighting: Quartz is coloured matter, not physically emissive light; no real geology deformation
style_guide.avoid: Avoid two adjacent dominant verticals; do not imply unsupported portalling, powder suspension or liquid containment
